title.zh: 通过进一步修订第589号共和国法第7条，延长该法（即《修订第466号联邦法（即《国家国内税收法典》，经修正）第133、134、135、137、140与147条》）效力的法案
title.en: An Act to Extend the Effectivity of Republic Act Numbered Five Hundred and Eighty-Nine, by Further Amending Section Seven Thereof, Entitled “An Act to Amend Sections One Hundred and Thirty-Three, One Hundred and Thirty-Four, One Hundred and Thirty Five, One Hundred and Thirty-Seven, One Hundred and Forty, and One Hundred and Forty-Seven of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred and Sixty-Six, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code, as Amended”
title.orig: An Act to Extend the Effectivity of Republic Act Numbered Five Hundred and Eighty-Nine, by Further Amending Section Seven Thereof, Entitled “An Act to Amend Sections One Hundred and Thirty-Three, One Hundred and Thirty-Four, One Hundred and Thirty Five, One Hundred and Thirty-Seven, One Hundred and Forty, and One Hundred and Forty-Seven of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred and Sixty-Six, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code, as Amended”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1090_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section seven of Republic Act Numbered Five hundred and eighty-nine, as amended by Republic Act numbered Seven hundred and twenty-four, and Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and fifty-five, is further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 7. This Act shall take effect upon its approval, but, unless otherwise expressly extended by Congress, the increased rates of tax provided for in this Act shall continue in force and effect until December thirty-one nineteen hundred and fifty-five."<<

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1954.
